headline: **MLB Recap: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a crucial win in their matchup against the Cleveland Guardians, edging out 6-4. Chase DeLauter led the Guardians' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. The Miami Marlins shut down the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-0, with Esteury Ruiz leading the Marlins' offense with a home run and an RBI. The Chicago Cubs took down the Washington Nationals 8-6, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. The Los Angeles Dodgers have transferred Blake Treinen to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The Boston Red Sox have moved Isiah Kiner-Falefa to the 60-day injured list. The New York Yankees have placed Kervin Castro on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, due to right elbow neuritis. Other teams have also reported injuries, including the Cincinnati Reds, Toronto Blue Jays, Miami Marlins, San Francisco Giants, and Colorado Rockies.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the 8/3 Adley Rutschman trade. The Miami Marlins have traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Athletics have acquired RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Cleveland Guardians 6-4, securing a crucial win in their matchup. Chase DeLauter led the Guardians' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Pirates in 2-0 Rout**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, winning 2-0 behind a strong pitching performance. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Eury Pérez earned the win with 7 scoreless innings.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Nationals 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jacob Webb earned the save with 1.1 scoreless innings, striking out 2 batters.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Mariners 4-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 4-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Randy Arozarena leading the Mariners' offense with a home run and an RBI. Bryan Woo pitched 5 strong innings for the Mariners, striking out 5 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Dodgers' Treinen Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the 8/3 Adley Rutschman trade. The player to be named later will come from the Red Sox.
